purpose: Reconcile repository branch/ref families, workstream/qualification lanes and ambiguous historical refs against the current System Master topology and P6 module dispositions without allowing branch names, workstream IDs, qualification IDs or stale transport refs to create architecture or current execution authority.
rules: A branch name cannot create a system, owner, qualification PASS or product obligation.
The canonical owner ref outranks implementation, request, repair, transport, qualification, archive and candidate refs.
Historical branches are preserved as evidence even when superseded; P7 does not delete refs.
A candidate or hosted-pass branch remains evidence until the canonical owner explicitly admits/promotes it under the correct exact-SHA authority.
Shared A-01, runner, repair, Second Shift and qualification refs are infrastructure/evidence, not product systems.
P6 owner-selection-required product modules remain product-architecture obligations even when no matching current branch is found; absence of a branch does not cancel the requirement.
Ambiguous evidence is classified EVIDENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED or OWNER_SELECTION_REQUIRED rather than guessed.

These refs preserve Core, continuity, assurance, A-01 and qualification history. None outranks current Core control or creates a new system.
Current objectives are selected only by system-master/control-v2 and current durable governance.
